title: Evaluating accuracy and reasoning capabilities of large language models for acute ischemic stroke management

live_model.evidence: Four LLMs were evaluated: o3-mini (OpenAI API, version o3-mini-2025-01-31), LLaMA 3.3-70B-Instruct ... accessed in March 2025 using fixed checkpoints (Methods)

prompt.location: Methods, 'LLM inference and prompt structure' (single template with bracketed patient fields)
prompt.note: Template is verbatim; the 80 case vignettes are the missing inputs.

claim.location: Results text and Table 2, row 'OpenAI o3 mini' (MT accuracy 0.80, Jaccard 0.473); cohort n=80 (Table 1)

data.source: 80 anonymized stroke patient vignettes from the authors' centers; 'available upon reasonable request'

notes: Provider-default decoding, no seed; treatment eligibility parsed by keyword matching. Clinical data are not public.
